did_you_know.text: Did you know? According to the passage, the LORD will pour out his Spirit on all people, without distinction between different groups among the people.
Did you know? The sons and daughters of Israel are described as prophesying—that is, receiving the ability to speak on behalf of the LORD.
Did you know? The verse distinguishes between different forms of revelation by age: the elders will dream dreams, and the young men will see visions.
Did you know? Slaves, both male and female, are explicitly included among those who receive the LORD’s Spirit, along with the rest of society.
Did you know? In the lead-up to the day of the LORD, signs are described in both the heavens and on earth: blood, fire, and pillars of smoke.
Did you know? The signs include changes in the heavenly lights: the sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood, before the coming of the great and awesome day of the LORD.
Did you know? The promise is that everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will escape; calling on the LORD’s name is presented as a way to be saved.
Did you know? Mount Zion and Jerusalem are presented as places where there will be deliverance, and the survivors whom the LORD calls are also mentioned.
